295				return dbErrorMsg(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to count webhooks: %v", err))
296			}
297	
298			offset := page * pageSize
299			rows, err := db.Query(`
300				SELECT id, timestamp, method, path, headers, body, body_json
301				FROM webhooks
302				ORDER BY id DESC
303				LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
304			`, pageSize, offset)
305			if err != nil {
306				return dbErrorMsg(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to load webhooks: %v", err))
307			}
308			defer rows.Close()
309	
310			var webhooks []WebhookPayload
311			for rows.Next() {
312				var w WebhookPayload
313				var headersJSON, bodyJSON string
314				var timestamp string
315	
316				err := rows.Scan(&w.ID, &timestamp, &w.Method, &w.Path, &headersJSON, &w.Body, &bodyJSON)
317				if err != nil {
318					continue
319				}
320	
321				// Try multiple timestamp formats
322				for _, format := range []string{
323					time.RFC3339,
324					"2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00",
325					"2006-01-02 15:04:05",
326					"2006-01-02T15:04:05",
327				} {
328					if t, err := time.Parse(format, timestamp); err == nil {
329						w.Timestamp = t
330						break
331					}
332				}
333				json.Unmarshal([]byte(headersJSON), &w.Headers)
334				if bodyJSON != "" {
335					json.Unmarshal([]byte(bodyJSON), &w.BodyJSON)
336				}
337	
338				webhooks = append(webhooks, w)
339			}
340	
341			return webhooksLoadedMsg{
342				webhooks:    webhooks,
343				totalCount:  totalCount,

345			}
346		}

443	func startTunnel(port, subdomain string) tea.Cmd {
444		return func() tea.Msg {
445			args := []string{"localtunnel", "--port", port}
446			if subdomain != "" {
447				args = append(args, "--subdomain", subdomain)
448			}
449	
450			cmd := exec.Command("npx", args...)
451			// Set process group so we can kill all children on exit
452			cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
453			stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
454			if err != nil {
455				return tunnelErrorMsg(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to create stdout pipe: %v", err))
456			}
457	
458			if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
459				return tunnelErrorMsg(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to start localtunnel: %v", err))
460			}
461	
462			// Read the URL from stdout
463			buf := make([]byte, 1024)
464			n, err := stdout.Read(buf)
465			if err != nil {
466				return tunnelErrorMsg(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to read tunnel URL: %v", err))
467			}
468	
469			output := string(buf[:n])
470			// Parse out the URL from localtunnel output
471			// Output typically looks like: "your url is: https://xxx.loca.lt"
472			url := output
473			if idx := strings.Index(output, "https://"); idx != -1 {
474				url = strings.TrimSpace(output[idx:])
475				if newline := strings.Index(url, "\n"); newline != -1 {
476					url = url[:newline]
477				}
478			}
479	
480			return tunnelStartedMsg{url: url, cmd: cmd}
481		}
482	}

484	func (m *Model) startWebhookServer() tea.Cmd {
485		return func() tea.Msg {
486			port := m.portInput.Value()
487			if port == "" {

489			}
490	
491			webhookChan := m.webhookChan
492			counter := 0
493			counterMu := &sync.Mutex{}
494	
495			http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
496				body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
497				if err != nil {
498					http.Error(w, "Failed to read body", http.StatusBadRequest)
499					return
500				}
501				defer r.Body.Close()
502	
503				counterMu.Lock()
504				counter++
505				id := counter
506				counterMu.Unlock()
507	
508				headers := make(map[string]string)
509				for k, v := range r.Header {
510					headers[k] = strings.Join(v, ", ")
511				}
512	
513				payload := WebhookPayload{
514					ID:        id,
515					Timestamp: time.Now(),
516					Method:    r.Method,
517					Path:      r.URL.Path,
518					Headers:   headers,
519					Body:      string(body),
520				}
521	
522				// Try to parse body as JSON for pretty display
523				var jsonBody interface{}
524				if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &jsonBody); err == nil {
525					payload.BodyJSON = jsonBody
526				}
527	
528				// Save to database
529				saveWebhookToDB(payload)
530	
531				select {
532				case webhookChan <- payload:
533				default:
534					// Channel full, drop oldest
535				}
536	
537				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
538				w.Write([]byte("OK"))
539			})
540	
541			go func() {
542				if err := http.ListenAndServe(":"+port, nil); err != nil {
543					// Server error - in production we'd send this as a message
544				}
545			}()
546	
547			return serverStartedMsg{}
548		}

580		}

583	func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
584		var cmds []tea.Cmd
585	
586		switch msg := msg.(type) {
587		case tea.KeyMsg:
588			// Handle signature verification mode input first
589			if m.signatureMode {
590				switch m.signatureStep {
591				case 0: // Entering secret
592					switch msg.String() {
593					case "enter":
594						secret := m.secretInput.Value()

596						if err != nil {
597							m.signatureResult = errorStyle.Render("Error: " + err.Error())
598						} else if hmac.Equal([]byte(computed), []byte(m.signatureValue)) {
599							m.signatureResult = successStyle.Render("MATCH") +
600								"\n  Computed: " + computed +
601								"\n  Expected: " + m.signatureValue
602						} else {
603							m.signatureResult = errorStyle.Render("MISMATCH") +
604								"\n  Computed: " + computed +
605								"\n  Expected: " + m.signatureValue
606						}
607						m.signatureStep = 2
608						m.secretInput.Blur()
609						return m, nil
610					case "esc":
611						m.signatureMode = false
612						m.secretInput.Blur()
613						m.secretInput.SetValue("")
614						return m, nil
615					default:
616						var cmd tea.Cmd
617						m.secretInput, cmd = m.secretInput.Update(msg)
618						return m, cmd
619					}
620				case 1: // Algorithm selection
621					switch msg.String() {
622					case "j", "down":
623						if m.algoSelectedIdx < len(m.algoChoices)-1 {
624							m.algoSelectedIdx++
625						}
626						return m, nil
627					case "k", "up":
628						if m.algoSelectedIdx > 0 {
629							m.algoSelectedIdx--
630						}
631						return m, nil
632					case "enter":
633						m.signatureAlgo = m.algoChoices[m.algoSelectedIdx]
634						m.signatureStep = 0
635						m.secretInput.SetValue("")
636						m.secretInput.Focus()
637						return m, textinput.Blink
638					case "esc":
639						m.signatureMode = false
640						return m, nil
641					}
642					return m, nil
643				case 2: // Result display
644					m.signatureMode = false
645					m.secretInput.SetValue("")
646					return m, nil
647				}
648			}
649	
650			// Handle search mode input first
651			if m.searchMode {
652				switch msg.String() {
653				case "enter":
654					// Execute search
655					m.searchMode = false
656					m.searchQuery = m.searchInput.Value()
657					m.searchInput.Blur()
658					if m.searchQuery != "" {
659						m.findSearchMatches()
660						m.updateDetailViewport() // Re-render with highlighting
661						if len(m.searchMatches) > 0 {
662							m.searchMatchIdx = 0
663							m.viewport.SetYOffset(m.searchMatches[0])
664						}
665						cmds = append(cmds, tea.ClearScreen)
666					}
667					return m, tea.Batch(cmds...)
668				case "esc":
669					// Cancel search
670					m.searchMode = false
671					m.searchInput.Blur()
672					m.searchInput.SetValue("")
673					// Clear highlighting
674					m.searchQuery = ""
675					m.searchMatches = nil
676					m.updateDetailViewport()
677					cmds = append(cmds, tea.ClearScreen)
678					return m, tea.Batch(cmds...)
679				default:
680					// Pass to search input
681					var cmd tea.Cmd
682					m.searchInput, cmd = m.searchInput.Update(msg)
683					return m, cmd
684				}
685			}
686	
687			switch msg.String() {
688			case "ctrl+c", "q":
689				if m.tunnelCmd != nil && m.tunnelCmd.Process != nil {
690					// Kill the process group to also kill child processes
691					syscall.Kill(-m.tunnelCmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGTERM)
692					m.tunnelCmd.Process.Kill()
693				}
694				return m, tea.Quit
695	
696			case "tab", "shift+tab":
697				if m.state == StateSetup {
698					if msg.String() == "shift+tab" {
699						m.focusedInput = (m.focusedInput + 3) % 4 // Go backwards
700					} else {
701						m.focusedInput = (m.focusedInput + 1) % 4
702					}
703					// Update focus states
704					m.portInput.Blur()
705					m.subdomainInput.Blur()
706					m.timeoutInput.Blur()
707					m.forwardURLInput.Blur()
708					switch m.focusedInput {
709					case 0:
710						m.portInput.Focus()
711					case 1:
712						m.subdomainInput.Focus()
713					case 2:
714						m.timeoutInput.Focus()
715					case 3:
716						m.forwardURLInput.Focus()
717					}
718				}
719	
720			case "enter":
721				if m.state == StateSetup {
722					m.state = StateRunning
723					port := m.portInput.Value()
724					if port == "" {
725						port = "8098"
726					}

729					// Parse timeout (default 30 minutes)

733					}
734					if minutes, err := strconv.Atoi(timeoutStr); err == nil && minutes > 0 {
735						m.tunnelTimeout = time.Duration(minutes) * time.Minute

738					}

743					m.forwardURL = strings.TrimSpace(m.forwardURLInput.Value())

746				} else if m.state == StateRunning && len(m.webhooks) > 0 {

748					// Set viewport content for the selected webhook

1363	// detectSignatureHeader scans headers for known webhook signature patterns.
1364	// Returns the header name, detected algorithm (or ""), and the signature value.
1365	func detectSignatureHeader(headers map[string]string) (headerName, algo, sigValue string) {
1366		for k, v := range headers {
1367			lower := strings.ToLower(k)
1368			switch lower {
1369			case "x-hub-signature-256":
1370				if strings.HasPrefix(v, "sha256=") {
1371					return k, "sha256", strings.TrimPrefix(v, "sha256=")
1372				}
1373				return k, "sha256", v
1374			case "x-hub-signature":
1375				if strings.HasPrefix(v, "sha1=") {
1376					return k, "sha1", strings.TrimPrefix(v, "sha1=")
1377				}
1378				return k, "sha1", v
1379			}
1380		}
1381		// Fallback: look for any header containing "signature" (case-insensitive)
1382		for k, v := range headers {
1383			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(k), "signature") {
1384				// Try to parse "algo=hex" format
1385				if idx := strings.Index(v, "="); idx > 0 {
1386					prefix := strings.ToLower(v[:idx])
1387					switch prefix {
1388					case "sha1", "sha256", "sha512":
1389						return k, prefix, v[idx+1:]
1390					}
1391				}
1392				// Unknown format — return without algo
1393				return k, "", v
1394			}
1395		}
1396		return "", "", ""
1397	}

1399	// computeHMAC computes an HMAC using the given algorithm, secret, and body.
1400	func computeHMAC(algo, secret, body string) (string, error) {
1401		var h func() hash.Hash
1402		switch algo {
1403		case "sha1":
1404			h = sha1.New
1405		case "sha256":
1406			h = sha256.New
1407		case "sha512":
1408			h = sha512.New
1409		default:
1410			return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported algorithm: %s", algo)
1411		}
1412		mac := hmac.New(h, []byte(secret))
1413		mac.Write([]byte(body))
1414		return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil)), nil
1415	}
